title: Disciple of Focus
summary: Challenge the Disciple of Focus during the monk epic sequence.
overview: Challenge the Disciple of Focus during the monk epic sequence.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Complete the dialogue with the eligible monk and have the party prepared before the challenge.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: An eligible monk at the relevant second-epic stage can hail the disciple and say 'challenge'.
The challenge advances the initial eligible stage, removes the disciple's protection and starts combat.
Leaving combat stops all quest timers.

notes: Approval R020. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
